rows.grounds: compound of muṣṭi (fist), mātra (measure), and aṅkura (sprout), instrumental plural
indeclinable adverb meaning together or with
causative optative of yuj (to join or yoke)
locative singular of ghaṭa (pot or jar)

items.question: How should the sprouts be combined in the pot?
items.inference: The ritual vessel receives sprouts together with water and buttermilk.
items.plain_english: Combine a fistful of sprouts together in one pot.
